description: Historical planted-error outcomes from five series of one content-plan review (the example material is replaced by the fictional bakery), transcribed by hand for `gauntlet ledger import-legacy`. Every row is contaminated, for a reason per series: in r8-r10 the executor who planted the errors also wrote the reviewers' checklists; in the blind re-check the person who planted them knew the material, and the old arm reused the executor's round-7 prompts. The old arm noticed 5 of 25 pairs, 4 at full class. The r8 per-pair figures come from the maintainer's answer summary of that series. No omission canaries were planted (omission recall: no data). Canary types were assigned during transcription (the sources name none). Severities of r8-r10 cells were not recorded; r9 and r10 have only per-lens counts, so only their own-lens cells are detection rows and their pair totals are aggregate rows ({legacyId, k, n, unit}) in detections.jsonl.
